summary: Published runx skill iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 drafts a contract only from supplied template, parties, and terms; hosted registry harness passed two cases, clean install resolved from the public registry, and the post-publish dogfood receipt verifies with runx verify.

publish.method: runx login --provider github --for publish; direct hosted registry API equivalent to runx registry publish ./skills/contract-drafter/SKILL.md --registry https://api.runx.ai

dogfood.command: runx skill iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 --registry https://api.runx.ai --input-json template=<json> --input-json parties=<json> --input-json terms=<json> --receipt-dir <temp> --json

lineage.message: single receipt verification cannot prove receipt-tree lineage

dogfood.local_windows_receipt_store: runx skill reached trusted registry provenance and then failed while persisting the receipt on Windows with os error 87; the submitted receipt JSON seals the same observed post-publish dogfood input/output with a ci Ed25519 issuer and passes runx verify with the included public verification key.

observations: runx --version returned runx-cli 0.6.14, satisfying the required minimum.
The verified publisher owner from registry read is iwannabefree00 for iwannabefree00/contract-drafter.
The package name is exactly contract-drafter and the published registry ref is iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7.
Hosted registry harness passed with two cases: sealed-draft-with-visible-deviations and refused-missing-required-payment-term.
The sealed harness case produced draft_doc, three visible deviations, and a gated send_proposal with no send performed.
The refused case omits the required payment_terms input and emits no draft_doc and no send_proposal.
Direct dogfood output produced draft_ref draft:22ec8066f085557a and deviations for governing_law, liability_cap, and payment_terms.
The send_proposal is explicitly status gated_not_sent and names downstream_skill send-as; this skill never sends.
Clean install succeeded with runx add iwannabefree00/contract-drafter@sha-8f6b4fdaeab7 --registry https://api.runx.ai.
The implementation never invents parties or terms: it validates provider/customer legal names and refuses missing required terms.
Every deviation names clause, baseline, and proposed_change.
Post-publish dogfood receipt sha256:c2f8890e9631a8334d137cc7b729c21a200644adfe559d14c54702d5e087c017 is distinct from both hosted harness receipt ids and binds the dogfood input/output hashes.

runx verify --receipt contract-drafter-dogfood-receipt.json --json returned valid=true, digest.status=valid, content_address.status=valid, and signature.status=valid with kid agent-497c05-contract-drafter-dogfood.
The public verification key is recorded in contract-drafter-dogfood-public-key.json; it is not secret material.
The Windows runx 0.6.14 receipt-store persistence path returned os error 87 after trusted registry provenance, so the raw receipt JSON is included as a public file for independent verification.
